messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person walks slowly forward down the center of the paved area, with arms swinging slightly.","camera":"A third-person view follows from behind the person at a low angle, gradually pulling back to reveal more of the legs and ground.","clothing":"The person wears a cream sweater with a brown diamond and chain-like pattern, blue jeans, and tan shoes.","hair_color":"Blue","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a small top knot or bun.","identity":"A person with a slim build is seen from behind, with no visible face.","scene":"An outdoor fairground or amusement park with a striped carousel on the left, a circular ride on the right, metal crowd-control barriers, and a pale hazy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a brick-paved city street with a Union Jack flag to an outdoor fairground with a striped carousel on the left, a circular ride on the right, barriers, and a hazy sky. The person remains seen from behind with blue hair in a top knot, cream patterned sweater, blue jeans, and tan shoes, walking forward while the camera follows from behind and pulls back.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the fairground environment from the reference image while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: The person's facial expression cannot be verified because the face is not visible in either video.
unexpected_changes: The person's lighting and color tone appear warmer and more saturated in the new scene, consistent with the fairground environment but slightly different from the source street lighting.
